INTJ.catch: You already have the answer before the meeting starts.
INTJ.overview: By the time everyone starts talking it over, you already have an answer in your head. You think about where things are going and pick the way with the least wasted effort. You stay quiet the whole meeting, then sum it all up in one line at the end. That happens a lot. You don't talk much, but when people ask you for advice, you give them something they can really use.
strengths: You plan ahead｜On a trip, you've picked a rainy-day backup before you even leave. So things rarely go wrong later.
You think it through on your own｜You don't decide just because others say so. You look into it and decide once it makes sense to you.
You spot wasted effort｜You're quick to ask, “Do we even need this step?” It saves everyone time.
pitfalls: You only give the conclusion｜It all connects in your head, but to others it sounds sudden. Try adding a quick “because…” after your conclusion.
Other people's long way around bugs you｜You can see a faster way, and waiting is hard. Before you jump in, watch how they do it until the end.
You don't ask for help｜“It's faster if I do it,” so you just do it yourself. This week, ask someone to take one small task.
INTJ.relationships: You're fine with a few friends. You're quiet in the group chat, but when someone asks you for advice one-on-one, you send a long reply. Once you get close to someone, it lasts. You're most comfortable with people who leave you alone when you need time to yourself.
INTJ.love: It takes you a while to fall for someone. But once you're together, you take it very seriously. You show your feelings more by talking about the future than by saying “I like you.” After a date, try sending a quick “Let's go again.” It'll make them happy.
INTJ.work: You do well where the goal is clear and you get to choose how to reach it. People say, “Ask them and you'll know how to move forward.” Rules with no reason and meetings where nothing gets decided wear you out. Block off focus time first, and work goes more smoothly.
INTJ.growth: Your conclusions are usually right. Today, when you share one, add a few words on why you think so.
INTJ.A: Once you decide, you go ahead without second-guessing. You don't get thrown when people around you get noisy about it.
INTJ.T: You check your plans again and again for anything off. When you get anxious, talking it over once with someone you trust helps you calm down.

INTP.catch: You start looking something up, and suddenly it's midnight.
INTP.overview: When something catches your interest, you can spend hours looking into it. You'd rather figure out why something works than just memorize the answer. You mean to look up one thing before bed, and suddenly it's 2 a.m. That happens a lot. You seem to do your own thing, but talk to you and you come up with answers no one expected.
strengths: You get how things work｜Even after a confusing explanation, you can say, “So basically, it's this,” in a few words.
You don't just believe what you hear｜Even when “everyone's saying it,” you check for yourself first.
You get really into what you like｜A game or topic you're hooked on? Before long, you know a lot about it.
pitfalls: You overthink and can't decide｜“There might be a better way,” so you never quite start. Set your own date, like “I'll decide by Friday.”
Feelings talk is hard for you｜A friend is venting, and you start offering fixes. Try starting with, “That sounds really rough.”
Half-done things pile up｜When something new grabs you, the old thing stops halfway. Before starting something new, finish just one thing.
INTP.relationships: You'd rather talk about what you love with a few people than hang out in a big group. People count on you because you say, “I looked it up.” With people who don't mind when you go quiet to think, and who jump in with “That's interesting,” you can talk forever.
INTP.love: It starts with “I want to know more about this person.” You get closer by talking a lot. Sometimes you overthink a reply to your crush and three days go by. Even a short “Here's what happened today” makes them feel better.
INTP.work: Work where you can think at your own pace and try new things suits you. You get praised for finding causes and building systems. Doing the same steps over and over, or writing reports that seem pointless, wears you out. Once you know why you're doing it, you can focus.
INTP.growth: You don't have to wait until an idea is finished to share it. Today, tell one person about an idea that's only half done.
INTP.A: You casually share what you come up with. You're fine even if your thoughts aren't sorted out yet.
INTP.T: You double-check for mistakes before you share anything. When you're stuck, share what you know so far.

ENTJ.catch: You're the one who says, “Okay, let's do this.”
ENTJ.overview: When everyone's stuck and unsure, you're the one who says, “Okay, let's do this.” Once there's a goal, you quickly work out the order of things and get people moving. A group chat stuck on “Where should we go?” gets settled fast once you suggest three options. When you seem strict, it's only because you want a good result.
strengths: You settle things｜When it's all “Either is fine,” you can say, “Let's go with this one today.”
You're good at breaking things down｜You can split a big goal into “today” and “next week.” Who does what gets clear fast.
Hard things fire you up｜When someone says, “Isn't that impossible?” it makes you want to try even more.
pitfalls: You expect others to keep your pace｜You assume everyone can move as fast as you. Before asking for something, check, “Are you busy right now?”
You can't relax when you rest｜Even on days off, you want to get something done. This weekend, keep half a day with nothing planned.
Criticism comes out first｜You point out problems right away, and people can feel down. Before giving a note, say one thing they did well.
ENTJ.relationships: When you go out with friends, you somehow end up deciding where and when. You don't mind being relied on, but taking time to really listen now and then brings you even closer. You build good relationships with people who say what they think.
ENTJ.love: You can say “I like you” straight out. You plan dates carefully and show you care through what you do. While listening to their problems, you might find yourself suggesting fixes. In those moments, just say, “I see,” and listen. That makes it easier for them to talk.
ENTJ.work: When there's a clear target and you're trusted with a lot, you give it your all. People rely on you to run projects and lead teams. Companies that take forever to decide, or work where results are hard to see, wear you out. The more you deliver, the more you get trusted with.
ENTJ.growth: When you go quiet for a bit, the quieter people start to talk. At the end of today's meeting, ask once, “Anyone have other ideas?”
ENTJ.A: You decide fast and can lead with confidence, even under pressure.
ENTJ.T: You notice small worries quickly. When you're pushing too hard for perfect, count what you got done today.

ENTP.catch: You're the one who says, “What if we flip it?”
ENTP.overview: When everyone thinks, “That's just how it's done,” you're the one asking, “What if we did it the other way?” As you talk, the ideas keep piling up. Sometimes it starts as small talk and turns into a whole new project. You may look like you love to argue, but you're not trying to win. You just want a better answer.
strengths: You think of other ways fast｜When a discussion gets stuck, you keep tossing out, “Then how about this?”
Your ideas grow as you talk｜Chatting with friends, a small thought turns into a big plan.
You'll talk to anyone｜Bosses or people you just met, you start talking easily. You're good at introducing people, too.
pitfalls: Finishing is hard for you｜Starting is fun, but you get bored at the end. Ask someone who likes finishing to help with the last part.
You get too heated｜It's so fun that you miss when the other person is tired. Every so often, ask, “What do you think?”
You jump at fun offers｜You say yes every time you're invited, then can't keep up. Before you reply, take a look at your week.
ENTP.relationships: You fit into any group fast and get people talking. You're also good at sending random thoughts in a chat and getting a conversation going. You like people who sometimes push back. Friends you can argue with for fun stay close for years.
ENTP.love: You fall for people who are fun to talk to or who show you things you didn't know. You invite them to new places to keep dates fun. Sometimes a joke you meant lightly really hurts them. When things get serious, start by saying, “Oh, I didn't know that.”
ENTP.work: You like places where you can take on new things and share ideas freely. You're great at starting projects and finding new ways to solve problems. Doing the same tasks every day wears you out. The more a job changes, the more you enjoy it.
ENTP.growth: You've already come up with lots of ideas. Pick one of them and decide on the very first step.
ENTP.A: When you think of something, you start on it that same day. If it doesn't work out, you don't get too down.
ENTP.T: You check once, “Will this really work?” You watch how people react, so you're good at how you say things.

INFJ.catch: You can tell from one “I'm fine” that they're not.
INFJ.overview: You notice when someone's face, voice, or reply speed changes even a little. A friend says “I'm fine,” and you just know they're not. People sometimes ask, “How did you know?” There's something you hope will happen, and you're happy when even a little of it comes true. You're calm and a good listener, but you're clear about what you won't give up.
strengths: You notice who's down｜Even in a group, you notice the one person who isn't laughing. Later you can ask, “Are you okay?”
You listen all the way｜You wait until the other person is done talking. People feel, “I can tell them,” and come to you with big things.
You have your own views｜Even if everyone else agrees, you don't go along if you think it's wrong.
pitfalls: You take on other people's problems｜After hearing a friend out, you end up feeling down too. When you're done listening, put on music you like to reset.
You hold it in too long｜You don't want trouble, so small complaints build up. Before they pile up, try a light “Something's been bugging me a little.”
You're hard on yourself｜When things don't go as planned, you get really down. Decide, “Half done is good enough today.”
INFJ.relationships: You may not have many friends, but you value the ones who last. In a group, you often end up listening, and people say, “Talking to you calms me down.” What matters isn't how often you meet but whether you can really talk. You get along with people who don't find silence awkward.
INFJ.love: As you talk, you start thinking, “I like how this person thinks,” and slowly fall for them. You can tell right away when they're not themselves, and you show kindness more by doing than saying. You go along with them so much that you never say where you want to eat. Saying just one “I want to go here” brings you closer.
INFJ.work: If the work feels meaningful, you can keep at it. Even more so when you can see you're helping someone. People appreciate you for giving advice or planning things with people's feelings in mind. Workplaces that only chase numbers, or are full of meetings, wear you down. Setting aside quiet time alone once a week keeps you steady.
INFJ.growth: People who notice others' feelings often put their own last. Tonight before bed, think of one thing that made you happy today.
INFJ.A: You trust your own thinking and act calmly. When it matters, you can say clearly, “Here's what I think.”
INFJ.T: You worry a lot about upsetting people. Because of that, you choose your words kindly. On days you worry too much, tell yourself, “I was thoughtful today,” and rest.

INFP.catch: You're often lost in “what if” stories in your head.
INFP.overview: On the train or on a lazy afternoon, “What if…” stories start playing in your head. Your favorite music, books, and views easily touch you. On a 10-minute walk home from the station, a whole story can take shape in your head. You're clear about what matters to you, and you just can't get into things that don't fit. You may seem quiet, but talk to you and you're unique and funny.
strengths: Little things move you｜You notice flowers by the road or a friend's offhand comment, and it gets to you.
You understand people who are hurting｜You can listen to a friend who's down without judging. Just having you there helps.
You can say hard things gently｜You think of ways to say things that won't hurt people. You rarely use harsh words.
pitfalls: You overthink and can't start｜Your imagination gets big, and the first step feels heavy. Tell yourself, “I'll just get ready,” and get your things out.
You swallow what you want to say｜You don't want to hurt anyone, so you end up not saying your opinion. Try a light “I think I like this one.”
You blame yourself｜When things go wrong, you decide it's your fault. Say to yourself what you'd say to a friend.
INFP.relationships: You prefer slow talks with a few people you click with. Once you're close, you can't stop talking about what you love. You hate fighting, so you often end up easing tense moments. You feel at ease with people who don't rush you and enjoy the things you like.
INFP.love: You long for someone you can tell anything. When you like someone, you play their favorite songs over and over and remember small things they said. You're not even dating yet, but in your head you're already imagining your future together. Saying small feelings out loud brings you closer.
INFP.work: You feel motivated in work that fits your values or where you can see you're helping someone. You're good at work like design or planning, where you can share your own ideas. A job that's nothing but quotas kills your motivation. Finding one thing you like in the job makes it easier to keep going.
INFP.growth: What's in your head gets across when you show it to people. Today, take a photo of one thing you liked.
INFP.A: You feel sure about what you like. Even when you're down, you bounce back fairly fast. You can say, “I love this,” with confidence.
INFP.T: You feel small changes in your mood strongly. That also helps you notice when others are hurting. On anxious days, go out for a short walk.

ENFJ.catch: You say, “Want some help?” before anyone asks.
ENFJ.overview: When someone's having a hard time, you say, “Want some help?” before they even ask. When a younger coworker seems stuck, you invite them to dinner on the way home and listen. Watching people work hard and grow makes you happy, and before you know it, you're the one bringing everyone together. Because of that, you often miss that you're tired.
strengths: You tell people what's good about them｜“That was easy to follow.” “I like your hair.” You say it as soon as you notice. It gives people confidence.
You bring opinions together｜You listen to everyone and come up with a plan most people can agree on.
Your words have heart｜When you say, “Let's try it,” everyone else wants to try too.
pitfalls: You pile up favors｜You keep saying “Sure,” and suddenly your hands are full. Before taking on anything new, finish one thing first.
You try too hard to meet expectations｜You don't want to let anyone down, so you overdo it. Just once, try saying, “I can't this time.”
“For your own good” gets heavy｜Advice you mean well can feel like a lot to the other person. Before giving advice, ask, “What would help?”
ENFJ.relationships: You know people in lots of different groups and often connect them. You also love telling one friend about another friend's good points. Having someone who'll listen when you need to vent makes you feel safe. Friendships last with people who listen to you when you're feeling low.
ENFJ.love: When you like someone, you do all kinds of things to see them smile. You also take their dreams and worries seriously. Just one unread message can make you wonder, “Did I say something wrong?” and reread what you sent. Sometimes let yourself be the one who leans on them, and tell them what you'd like.
ENFJ.work: In work with people, being able to help someone makes you happy. People rely on you as a leader, a trainer, or the one who smooths things out. Long stretches of solo work or a tense office drain you. Work where you can watch people work hard and change up close keeps you going.
ENFJ.growth: You're great at supporting people, so check on how tired you are too. Today, for one request, say, “I'll get back to you,” and think it over first.
ENFJ.A: You're confident in your ideas and reach out to everyone. You can talk in front of a big crowd without getting nervous.
ENFJ.T: You pay close attention to how each person reacts. When you worry about what people think of you, remember the good things you've done for others.

ENFP.catch: The moment you say “That sounds fun!” you're already moving.
ENFP.overview: A new shop, a place you've never been, something nobody's tried yet. When you think, “That sounds fun!” you get excited right away. You want to share ideas the moment you have them, and small talk turns into idea after idea. You get close to new people fast, and before you know it, you've heard all about what they love. You seem lively, but you're sensitive to how people feel, and you get hurt easily too.
strengths: Ideas keep coming｜From one topic, you keep going, “Then what about this, too?”
You make friends fast｜After a little talking, you're already laughing with someone you just met.
You get people excited｜When you talk about something happily, someone always says, “Maybe I'll try it too.”
pitfalls: Your attention wanders｜Things you start have stopped before you notice. Pick one thing to finish and set a small “That's it for today” point.
You overbook yourself｜You can't say no to plans or to things you want to do, so your schedule fills up. Pick one day a week to keep empty, ahead of time.
Small tasks tire you out｜You keep putting off repetitive work and paperwork. Put on music you like and do just 15 minutes.
ENFP.relationships: You have lots of friends and get along with all kinds of people. You'll text, “Can you meet up now?” the moment you think of it, so you're often the one who starts plans. You get along with people who enjoy your ideas, and with people who say, “That'll cost money, you know,” at the right time.
ENFP.love: It usually starts with “I have fun with this person.” When you like someone, places you want to go together keep popping into your head. You send a long message on an exciting night, then feel embarrassed reading it the next morning. Making small fun things part of your everyday life together helps it last.
ENFP.work: Work where you can do new things and deal with all kinds of people makes every day fun. You're good at planning, launching things, and posting on social media. Repeating the same steps or being closely managed drains your motivation. Splitting tasks you don't like with people who are good at them frees up time for what you enjoy.
ENFP.growth: You're already great at starting. Today, pick one half-done thing and spend just 5 minutes on it.
ENFP.A: When you think of something, you go for it. Even if it fails, you say, “Next!” and move on fast.
ENFP.T: You seem cheerful, but you're actually paying a lot of attention to everyone around you. When it tires you out, take some time alone to do what you like.

ISTJ.catch: You do what you decided, the way you decided.
ISTJ.overview: You do what you decided, the way you decided, and you do it properly. Your assignments are done the day before, and you get to meetups 10 minutes early. You don't try to stand out, but you never cut corners on what you're given. You may seem a little hard to approach at first, but the longer people know you, the more they say, “If you ask them, it'll be fine.” You do your best when you have time to focus alone.
strengths: You keep your word｜When you say, “I'll take care of it,” you do. You don't miss deadlines either.
You catch mistakes｜If numbers in a table are off or a step is missing, you notice right away.
You can stick with plain things｜Morning workouts or studying, you keep at it quietly for years.
pitfalls: Last-minute changes wear you out｜When someone says on the day, “Let's go somewhere else,” it really drains you. Before going out, pick one backup place.
You don't say how you feel｜You don't say thanks or complaints, so people can get the wrong idea. When someone helps you, try saying, “That really helped.”
You try to do it all alone｜You feel it's surer if you do it yourself. Try handing off just part of the job.
ISTJ.relationships: You care more about friendships that last than about how many friends you have. You're the same with someone even after years apart. Busy, noisy gatherings tire you out, so you're most comfortable with people you can talk to calmly in a group of a few, and who don't rush you.
ISTJ.love: You don't fall for people fast, but once you decide, you're all in. You show your feelings less with words and more by remembering anniversaries or walking them to the station. Your replies are often just “Got it,” so people ask, “Are you mad?” Adding “That was fun” at the end is enough to get your feelings across.
ISTJ.work: You do your best where the rules and roles are clear. People rely on you for work that needs to be accurate or done reliably by the deadline. Workplaces where plans keep changing, or where you're suddenly asked to do things with no prep, are hard for you. Asking for time to gather information first helps you feel at ease.
ISTJ.growth: Add a little something different to your usual way of doing things. Taking one different street home today is plenty.
ISTJ.A: You feel sure about your way and keep going. Even after a mistake, you don't dwell on it and quickly think about what to do next.
ISTJ.T: You check carefully, so you hardly make mistakes. Sometimes tell yourself, “This is enough,” and stop.

ISFJ.catch: You quietly help out before anyone asks.
ISFJ.overview: You notice small changes in people and help out before they ask. When a coworker looks pale, you quietly leave a warm cup of tea on their desk. You keep doing things like that where no one really sees. You remember what people like and what they told you before, and you see your tasks through to the end. Before long, you're someone people can't do without.
strengths: You notice changes in people｜You notice right away when someone gets a haircut or sounds a bit lower than usual.
You remember things｜You remember a friend's favorite snack and the worries they told you about. People say, “You remembered?” and look happy.
You keep at it｜You don't cut corners, even on cleanup and prep no one notices. With you around, the team runs smoothly.
pitfalls: You can't say no｜You feel bad saying no, so you end up saying “Sure.” Instead of answering right away, try, “Let me think about it.”
You don't show you're tired｜You don't want people to worry, so you push it until you can't. Tell a family member or friend, “I'm a bit tired today.”
New things make you uneasy｜The way you're used to feels safer. Try just one new thing, in a small way.
ISFJ.relationships: You care more about the people close to you than being the center of a lively group. When a friend has a cold, you quietly drop off something for them. Friendships with people who notice how thoughtful you are last a long time.
ISFJ.love: You show your feelings by doing things for the person you like. You cook their favorite food or text often to check how they're feeling. When they give you a gift, you think, “What should I give back?” before you even feel happy. Sometimes just say “Thank you” and take it.
ISFJ.work: You do well in supporting roles or work where you follow steps carefully. Your care and accuracy keep the team going. You don't slack, even on work no one notices, but you quietly get worn out if no one notices. A workplace where people say “thank you” to each other is one you can stay at for a long time.
ISFJ.growth: Turn a little of the kindness you give others toward yourself. Today, do one thing you want to do first.
ISFJ.A: You only take on what you can handle, so you don't push yourself too hard. You don't agonize much over saying no.
ISFJ.T: You think about how others will feel, so you're very thoughtful. On tiring days, be kind to yourself too.

ESTJ.catch: You quickly sort out who does what.
ESTJ.overview: You're good at pulling the talk together and getting everyone moving. When a discussion goes nowhere, you naturally take over with, “Let's set a deadline and decide who does what.” You stick to what's decided and want others to as well. You say things plainly, so people can find you a bit scary, but when there's trouble, you're the one they count on most. “If I said it, I'll do it” is something you say a lot.
strengths: You get things organized fast｜Prepping for a school festival or a party, you line up the tasks and hand them out right away.
You're very responsible｜You never drop what you take on. People think, “If they've got it, we're fine.”
You follow the rules｜You stick to trash sorting and to the time. When things get sloppy, you tighten them up.
pitfalls: You sound bossy｜When you're in a hurry, you start sounding like you're giving orders. When you ask for something, start with, “Sorry, got a sec?”
You stick to your own way｜You trust the way that's worked before. Just this once, try doing it someone else's way.
You step in after handing it off｜You hand it off, then can't help saying, “You should do it like this.” Once you hand it off, wait until it's done.
ESTJ.relationships: You look after people and naturally end up leading your group. You often take on organizing reunions and parties. You trust people who keep their promises and say what they think. When people hint instead of saying things directly, you're a little lost.
ESTJ.love: In love, you're serious too, and you show you care through what you do. You decide the place and time for dates. But when they're late to meet you, your irritation can show on your face. When that happens, first ask, “Did something happen?”
ESTJ.work: You do well in places where goals and roles are clear. People rely on you to bring the team together and get results on time. Meetings that decide nothing or fuzzy rules get on your nerves. If you decide how to move forward yourself, things run smoothly.
ESTJ.growth: When you listen before deciding, people follow you more. Today, hear someone out all the way without cutting in.
ESTJ.A: You rarely hesitate and can decide on the spot. Even when people disagree, you can calmly explain your reasons.
ESTJ.T: You check ahead for problems that might come up. You also watch how people react, so they count on you as a gentle leader.

ESFJ.catch: You always check that everyone's having a good time.
ESFJ.overview: You always keep an eye on whether the people around you are having a good time. At get-togethers, you quickly notice who's out of drinks or who isn't part of the conversation. Birthdays and celebrations matter to you, and seeing people happy gives you energy. Before long, people are saying, “When they're here, everyone gets along.”
strengths: You connect people｜You step in between two people meeting for the first time and say, “You both have dogs, right?”
You speak up at just the right time｜When someone's struggling, you ask, “Need a hand?” at the right moment.
Celebrations matter to you｜You remember your friends' birthdays and celebrate every year.
pitfalls: You worry too much about reactions｜You want people to be happy, so you keep checking their faces. When there's no reply, first think, “Maybe they're busy.”
Your own plans come last｜While fitting into everyone else's schedule, you never get to your own errands. Once a week, put a plan just for you on the calendar first.
Criticism hits you hard｜You're working so hard that hearing “That's wrong” really hurts. They're talking about how you did it, not about you. Just think about what to change next time.
ESFJ.relationships: You're often put in charge of keeping the group in touch. You can't ignore someone who's struggling, so you sometimes become everyone's go-to for advice. You get along with people who have fun with you and enjoy the noise. When someone's cold to you, it stays on your mind for a long time.
ESFJ.love: You text the person you like often to show you're thinking of them. You also go all out for anniversaries. When they seem distant, you start to worry, “Do they not like me anymore?” When that happens, go ahead and ask, “How have you been lately?”
ESFJ.work: Work with people where you get thanked gives you energy. People rely on you to make the team feel good and keep it easy for everyone to work. Places that are all about competing tire you out, so choosing a team that helps each other lets you stay longer.
ESFJ.growth: You look out for others a lot, but you tend to forget about yourself. Today, buy yourself a little snack, just for you.
ESFJ.A: You don't get pulled around by how people react, and you can decide and move forward yourself. You're cheerful all the time, which puts people at ease.
ESFJ.T: You think carefully about how others feel, and your care reaches everyone. It gets easier when you remember it comes across fine even if it isn't perfect.

ISTP.catch: You learn how things work by trying them.
ISTP.overview: When you wonder, “How does this work?” you start by touching it and finding out. When a new appliance arrives, you skip the manual, play with it, and figure it out. You don't talk much, but when there's trouble, you stay calm, get your hands on it, and fix it fast. You value your own pace and freedom. Time spent working quietly alone is your best break.
strengths: You learn by doing｜You get better faster by trying it than by hearing about it.
Trouble doesn't rattle you｜Even when your computer suddenly freezes, you calmly find the cause and fix it.
You get things done quickly｜You do only what's needed, in the fewest steps.
pitfalls: You fix things without a word｜You fix it silently, so no one knows what happened. When you're done, say, “This part was broken.”
You don't know how to comfort people｜When a friend cries, you freeze up. Even if you can't find the words, sit next to them and nod.
Planning ahead is hard｜You like to decide in the moment. For important deadlines, at least set a reminder on your phone.
ISTP.relationships: You'd rather keep a few close friends loosely for a long time than know lots of people a little. Clingy relationships aren't your thing, and you're comfortable with someone who can be in the same room doing their own thing. You don't talk much, but you help quietly when there's trouble, so people slowly come to trust you.
ISTP.love: You're not good at putting your feelings into words, but they show in what you do. You fix their bike or grab their heavy bag without a word. They say, “You never say you like me,” and you think, “I fixed your bike, though.” Sometimes say it in words too, even if it's short.
ISTP.work: You like work where you solve problems with your hands and head. People count on you when you handle trouble with machines, tools, or data. Lots of small rules or long meetings are a bit hard on you. A place that lets you do things your way is easier.
ISTP.growth: “You'll get it once you try” is one of your strengths. Today, explain one thing you did to someone, in just a few words.
ISTP.A: You act as soon as you think of it. If it doesn't work, you quickly try another way.
ISTP.T: You check the details before you move. You care about how things turn out, so your work is careful.

ISFP.catch: You go with what you like.
ISFP.overview: Your own “I like this” matters a lot to you. Even on your usual way home, you stop to take a photo when the sunset is pretty. Rather than saying it, you show what you like through your clothes and things. You don't like clashing with people, but you quietly hold on to what matters. Being around things you love is enough to cheer you up.
strengths: You're good with colors｜You're good at arranging things in a room and putting outfit colors together.
You don't blame people｜Even when a friend messes up, you can say, “That happens.” People feel relaxed around you.
You lose track of time making things｜Once you start baking or drawing, it's dark outside before you know it.
pitfalls: You can't say what bothers you｜You don't want to fight, so you laugh it off. While it's still small, try saying, “That kind of bothered me.”
Planning ahead is hard for you｜You want to go with how you feel that day. Before bed, pick just one thing to do tomorrow.
Feedback on your work gets you down｜What you make feels close to who you are, so when people knock it, you get really down. When you hear feedback, ask about the good parts too.
ISFP.relationships: You'd rather spend quiet time with people you click with than go to big parties. You don't talk badly about anyone and are gentle with everyone, so people feel safe with you. You get close to people who match your pace and happily listen when you talk about what you love.
ISFP.love: When you like someone, you give them handmade things or quietly look out for them. You might find yourself buying things in their favorite color. It takes you time to say how you feel, so you match well with people who pay attention to your actions more than your words.
ISFP.work: Work that uses your sense of style and your skill with your hands suits you. You get praised for carefully looking after people or animals, or making things. Quotas and fierce competition tire you out. A place where you can take your time and finish at your own pace suits you.
ISFP.growth: When you show someone what you like, it gets a conversation going. Today, show a friend one thing you made or found.
ISFP.A: You trust what you like and go with it. You don't worry much about what others think and keep doing what you love.
ISFP.T: You're very sensitive to how others feel and notice small things. You sometimes redo things many times until you're happy with them.

ESTP.catch: You're quick to say, “Let's just try it.”
ESTP.overview: Your body moves before you've thought it through. When a meeting stalls, you're the first to raise your hand and say, “Let's just try it.” You read the room well and get out of trouble smoothly when it comes up. You're fun to talk to and make friends fast wherever you go, so you end up in the middle of the group. Sitting still for too long makes you restless.
strengths: You move fast｜You think while doing instead of hesitating. You don't miss sales or chances.
You think on your feet｜Even if the place you planned on is closed, you quickly find another one nearby.
You're a good talker｜You can joke around with someone you just met. Things get lively.
pitfalls: You start without preparing｜You figure it out as you go. For big things, think of one “What if it fails?” before you start.
Repeating the same thing bores you｜Without change, you can't stay focused. For dull tasks, set a timer and get through them.
You say what you think right away｜You say, “That doesn't really suit you, does it?” and then think, “Oops.” Before you speak, take one breath.
ESTP.relationships: Plans to hang out usually start with you. Stiff relationships aren't your thing, and you're happiest with people you can joke around with easily. You quickly hit it off with people who are up for anything. Relationships that tie you down make you feel trapped.
ESTP.love: When you like someone, you act fast and keep asking them out. You're a fun partner who never lets things get boring. But when the future comes up, you tend to change the subject. When it's something important, putting your phone down while you talk puts them at ease.
ESTP.work: You do well in fast-changing work where you see results quickly. People rely on you in sales or field work, getting results while moving with others. Desk jobs or places with lots of rules bore you. Choose a place that lets you move on your own.
ESTP.growth: Looking back a little after you act makes the next time go better. At the end of today, decide one “Next time I'll do this.”
ESTP.A: You're confident and act without hesitating. You jump into new places and naturally end up leading.
ESTP.T: You pay attention to what the people around you are thinking. You look back after you act and use it next time.

ESFP.catch: You're the one having the most fun.
ESFP.overview: You enjoy the moment to the fullest and make it fun for everyone around you. When a fun invite comes in, you've already said “I'm in!” before thinking twice. Your face is full of expression, and just talking with you brightens things up. When someone's feeling down, you make them laugh without making a big deal of it, so people naturally gather around you.
strengths: You brighten the mood｜Even when things are tense, your reactions make everyone laugh.
You notice when people are tired｜In the middle of having fun, you can say, “Let's take a break.”
You fit in anywhere｜New school, new job, or a trip, you make friends right away.
pitfalls: You go out even when you're tired｜If it sounds fun, you go even on little sleep. When you have an early morning, try saying no to the night plans.
Money slips away｜You tend to put fun in the moment first. When you want something, wait a night before buying it.
You avoid heavy talks｜You want to keep the mood light. For important talks, set aside a short time on a day separate from fun plans.
ESFP.relationships: You're the one keeping the group chat lively. You're good at connecting people, and you notice small changes in friends and check in on them. Having someone who listens quietly on days you're down makes you feel stronger.
ESFP.love: When you like someone, it shows on your face right away. You reach out as soon as you want to see them, and you make dates special with little surprises. Even after a fight, you're usually laughing again the next time you meet. You tend to put off important talks, so sometimes ask first, “What do you want for us going forward?”
ESFP.work: Work where you see customers' reactions right away suits you. In customer service or events, people praise your cheerfulness and care. Working alone at a screen all day wears you out. Working while talking with people is more fun.
ESFP.growth: Making plans a little ahead keeps the good times going longer. Today, set up one fun plan for next week.
ESFP.A: You don't worry much about what others think, and when it's fun, you go all in. Small slip-ups are forgotten after a night's sleep.
ESFP.T: Even while you're having fun, you keep an eye out for anyone who looks bored. You think about others a lot, so people trust you deeply.
